subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> from <Picture 1>: Exactly one adult blonde woman, age 30, with shoulder-length blonde hair, narrow black sunglasses, small gold hoop earrings and a tiny flower pendant. Preserve her black blazer, opaque high-neck ribbed top, black trousers and black boots. She always uses the single broad dark-steel greatsword shown in this reference. Keep its blade length, crossguard and gold edge unchanged. No bag or extra weapon.
<Subject 2> from <Picture 2>: The same broad suspended Eastern stone bridge above a cloud abyss, with weathered pillars, broken stone railings, giant iron chains, cliffs and distant ancient temple roofs. The center of the bridge remains wide enough for grounded combat. Use this as the sole location; do not copy the plain studio backgrounds of the character references.
<Subject 3> from <Picture 3>: Exactly one bone-white mechanical insectoid with cracked ceramic armor, black mechanical joints, two large scythe forelimbs, two smaller lower arms, two legs, antennae, damaged wings, one segmented tail and a warm-gold chest reactor. This is a machine, without organic flesh or blood. Maintain the same body plan throughout.

summary:
[reference generation] A continuous approximately 20-second dark-fantasy duel. The woman and the machine exchange readable attacks and counters on the same bridge. She progressively damages its shoulder armor and opens the chest guard before a final strike disables the reactor. Damage remains visible in later shots. High-end cinematic CG, cool mist against restrained red-gold blade energy; the energy follows the real sword path and never hides the fighters.

detailed_description:
Use six coherent shots, each with a clear action, stable screen direction and a visible cause-and-effect result. These times guide pacing rather than demand frame-perfect cuts. No slow motion, teleportation, frozen poses or repeated establishing shots.
[Shot 1, 00:00–00:03.5] Wide three-quarter view along the bridge: the woman is screen left and the machine screen right. The machine steps in with a crossing scythe attack. She plants her feet and blocks at the crossing point with both hands on the greatsword. One sharp impact and a narrow red-gold spark establish contact.
[Shot 2, 00:03.5–00:07] Medium lateral tracking view on the same side of the action. She slides her blade along one scythe, sidesteps the second, and answers with one short rising cut into the machine's near shoulder plate. A small white armor chip falls; the shoulder remains visibly cracked afterwards. The machine immediately counters rather than waiting.
[Shot 3, 00:07–00:10.5] Wider view preserves the two fighters' positions. The machine sweeps its segmented tail low while striking high with one scythe. She blocks high and steps over the tail without floating. The missed scythe breaks a section of railing behind her. That railing stays broken and does not reappear.
[Shot 4, 00:10.5–00:14] Close but legible three-quarter action view, both weapons in frame. She binds the intact scythe with her greatsword, turns her hips and drives one connected diagonal counter into the already-cracked shoulder. The damaged shoulder guard splits, exposing black mechanical structure. No severed organic limbs or blood. The machine retreats one grounded step and closes its chest guard.
[Shot 5, 00:14–00:17.5] Return to a wider view on the same camera axis. The machine makes one desperate scythe-and-tail counter. She parries the scythe, moves to the damaged shoulder side and cuts across the shoulder-to-chest seam. The chest plates separate enough to reveal the warm-gold reactor. Sparks and fragments travel from the actual points of contact, with no explosion covering the action.
[Shot 6, 00:17.5–00:20] Medium-wide finish: the machine lunges once more. She turns its remaining scythe aside, grounds both boots on the bridge and drives the unchanged greatsword into the exposed mechanical reactor housing. A brief concentrated gold flash, one deep impact, then the machine drops to its knees and its reactor dims. She regains a balanced guard as small debris settles. Both remain on the bridge; no victory pose or new scene.

overall_soundscape:
Synchronized metallic weapon contacts, boot scrapes on stone, mechanical joint movement, a low reactor hum, cracking stone, rattling chains and airy wind above the clouds. Differentiate blocked blows from misses. No dialogue, narration, vocals or human screams.
non_diegetic_music:
Restrained fast dark orchestral percussion and low brass below the combat sound effects. Do not drown out weapon contacts. Let the final impact and falling debris remain clearly audible.

Constraints: one woman and one mechanical opponent only; no gore, organic dismemberment, extra characters, extra weapons, costume or identity changes, duplicated limbs, hands fused to blades, implausible joint bending, levitation, spatial resets, repaired scenery, text, UI, logo or watermark. Keep both subjects readable with coherent scale and contact shadows.
